raw_text: United Liberation Front of Asom (Independent) claims responsibility for attacks on Oil India Limited pipeline infrastructure in Tinsukia district. Two valve stations along the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor were targeted using IEDs. This action is in response to continued exploitation of Assam's natural resources without adequate compensation to the people of Assam.
clean_text: ULFA-I claims responsibility for IED attacks on Oil India Limited pipeline valve stations in Tinsukia district along Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor.
